name: open-seo
description: Open source alternative to Semrush and Ahrefs
one_liner: A free, self-run alternative to expensive SEO tools like Semrush and Ahrefs, priced pay-as-you-go instead of a flat monthly subscription.
buyer: A solo SEO consultant or small marketing agency that can't justify a $200+/month Semrush seat for every client.
business_use_cases: A boutique SEO agency self-hosts it to cut monthly tool costs while still delivering full audits to clients.
A freelance SEO consultant runs it pay-as-you-go and passes the savings on as a cheaper audit package to small-business clients.
A solo blogger or course creator runs their own competitor and keyword analysis without paying for enterprise SEO software.

money_ideas.idea: Launch a low-cost, one-off "SEO health check" report service for local businesses, undercutting the usual $500+ agency audit price.
Offer a managed hosted version with a cheaper monthly tier than the big incumbents.

steal_this: Launch a $49 one-off "SEO health check" service for local businesses this weekend, using this instead of an expensive Semrush seat.
